attributes.title: APIC27 Annual Conference & Expo
attributes.cme_provider: Association for Professionals in Infection Control and Epidemiology (APIC)
attributes.organizer: Association for Professionals in Infection Control and Epidemiology
attributes.summary:
APIC27, the annual conference of the Association for Professionals in Infection Control and Epidemiology, runs June 14 to 16, 2027, at the Los Angeles Convention Center. APIC lists more than 100 educational sessions plus an exhibit floor and networking events.

APIC is accredited by ANCC as a provider of nursing continuing professional development, so infection-prevention nurses can earn contact hours here; the number of hours for 2027 is not published yet.

Attendee registration opens December 8, 2026. The registration site shows member rates of $715 early-bird and $815 regular, and $305 for student members; nonmember prices and the early-bird deadline are not published yet.
